title: How to try different video hooks on iPhone
job: In Vyra on iPhone version 0.1.8 or later, open Variations in the editor’s top bar. Make another version of the edit and try a different opening there. Preview the versions before choosing which one to export.

title: How to export several versions of a video on iPhone
job: In Vyra on iPhone version 0.1.8 or later, open Variations and choose Export all. Review the versions selected for export and start the export for the set you want.

title: How to add your logo to a video on iPhone
job: In Vyra on iPhone, add your logo image to the project and ask chat to place it over the footage. Specify the corner, size and the part of the video where it should appear.
source: Library on iPhone and Properties panel

title: How to remove a section from the middle of a video on iPhone
job: In Vyra on iPhone, split the clip at the beginning and end of the unwanted section, select the middle piece and delete it. Review the join and any remaining gap before exporting.
source: Editing tools on iPhone and Timeline navigation and tools

title: Ceramics video ideas to film with your phone
job: Start with a change the camera can show clearly. A clay wall becoming even, a trimmed foot or a glaze result gives a ceramics video a sequence to follow.
concepts: The rim before and after one pass
A glaze prediction and its result

title: Sewing video ideas for a repair or finished garment
job: A seam closing or a garment sitting differently can carry a sewing video. Choose one visible change and film the fabric before, during and after it.
concepts: One seam that fixes the fit
The inside of a finished piece

title: Jewelry video ideas that show scale and detail
job: Jewelry footage needs both a close view and a sense of scale. Give the viewer time to see the piece before asking them to read a caption.
concepts: A pair with a tiny difference

title: Printmaking video ideas built around the reveal
job: A print reveal has a natural ending. Film enough of the setup and the lift that the viewer can connect the result with the block or plate.
concepts: One pull from start to finish
The detail that did not print

title: Woodworking video ideas from the footage you already have
job: Choose a visible join, surface change or working detail for the video. Give the finished object enough context that viewers can understand its size and purpose.

title: Florist video ideas for an arrangement or delivery
job: A flower video can follow a shape taking form or show how an arrangement belongs in its setting. Choose the story before cutting the stems and room shots together.
concepts: One flower that changes the balance

title: Nail artist video ideas for a finished set
job: Give a finished nail set a clear close-up and enough time to see the details. Film any process shots around the feature you want the viewer to notice.
concepts: The detail under a moving hand
The color choice beside the result

title: Hair stylist video ideas from a finished appointment
job: Use consistent views to show the shape, length or finish you want people to notice. Keep enough of the final result on screen for the style to read.
concepts: The same turn before and after
One detail and the whole style

title: Bakery video ideas for one product or a morning batch
job: Build the video around something the viewer can see change. Dough becoming a shaped item, a cross-section or the first tray of the morning can each support a different edit.

title: Cafe video ideas beyond a fast drink montage
job: Pick a small moment that gives the cafe a recognizable story. A drink being finished, a counter opening or one regular order can work with a few phone clips.
concepts: A drink in the place it belongs
The counter before the first order

title: Thrift shop video ideas for finds and collections
job: Show a find clearly before cutting into styling or story. A useful thrift video gives viewers enough detail to understand what makes the item worth showing.
concepts: The detail that made you stop

title: Bookshop video ideas for shelves and recommendations
job: A bookshop video works best when the viewer can follow one recommendation or shelf idea. Let the covers and your reason for choosing them stay readable.
concepts: A shelf organized by a question
A display from empty to ready

title: Plant shop video ideas that show the actual plant
job: Show the plant’s overall shape as well as the leaf or growth detail that interests you. A clear full view helps viewers understand the close-up.

title: Illustration video ideas from sketches and finished work
job: Choose one decision in the drawing that the footage or saved images can show. A changed composition or color choice gives the edit a clear beginning and result.
concepts: One color that changed the mood

title: Craft market video ideas before and after the doors open
job: Give the market video a small story you can actually film. A stall being built, one product display or packing at the end can each make a complete sequence.

title: Art exhibition video ideas for the work and the room
job: An exhibition video should let viewers see both the artwork and its placement. Start with the part of the room or piece that gives the rest of the footage context.
concepts: One wall from wide to detail
The work with the artist’s words
